RTD will review proposals for alignment with requirements, long-term strategic fit, and overall value; including the maturity, flexibility, and extensibility of the proposed platform. RTD is interested in solutions that not only meet current needs but demonstrate the ability to support evolving business requirements, enable seamless integration across all ERP and other functional domains, and drive continuous improvement in business processes and data management. RTD encourages participation from all qualified ERP vendors and is committed to a fair, open, and competitive procurement process.
